path: I built a successful international career at the United Nations

text.content: I built a successful international career at the United Nations — working alongside diplomats, leading people across different cultures, and changing my career path several times along the way. I relocated to four countries, travelled constantly, and lived a life that, from the outside, looked extraordinary.And it was. I also had a husband I love, two children growing up too fast, and aging arents who needed me. Every role I played, I gave it everything. What I didn't realise was how far I had overstretched — until the day I simply couldn't go on anymore. Not because something broke. Because I had nothing left.That's when I stopped looking for a better strategy and started understanding how my brain actually works. That search led me to neuroscience —and changed everything.

layers.name: I built a successful international career at the United Nations
path: I built a successful international career at the United Nations

text.content: I built a successful international career at the United Nations — working alongside diplomats, leading people across different cultures, and changing my career path several times along the way. I relocated to four countries, travelled constantly, and lived a life that, from the outside, looked extraordinary.And it was. I also had a husband I love, two children growing up too fast, and aging arents who needed me. Every role I played, I gave it everything. What I didn't realise was how far I had overstretched — until the day I simply couldn't go on anymore. Not because something broke. Because I had nothing left.That's when I stopped looking for a better strategy and started understanding how my brain actually works. That search led me to neuroscience — and changed everything.
